description: The Peacekeeper-Scarran war reaches open catastrophe, forcing Crichton, Aeryn and their allies to use the threat of a wormhole weapon to impose peace while their own family finally begins.

s05e01-02.description: The Peacekeeper-Scarran war engulfs Moya's crew as Crichton and Aeryn survive their apparent deaths, reunite with old allies and search for a way to force peace.

s05e03-04.description: Crichton finally demonstrates the terrifying scale of a wormhole weapon, compelling both empires toward peace while Aeryn gives birth amid the last battle.
